channel: epbs/_threads/Check if pending deposit exists before applying to builder
searchText: the signature check doesn't seem to fully prevent front-running as as soon as the builder deposit is published someone (another builder who builds a block) may create a validator deposit and include it before the builder's one Attack cost is 1 ETH, if a builder's initial deposit is 1 ETH it might be fine to leave everything as is as then incentive for such attack is almost zero But the frontran validator deposit doesn't prevent the builder from being activated as long as we check its signature yeah, I see. agreed
